{{< include /_includes/follow-bluesky.md >}}

To get new posts in a feed reader, such as Feedly, Inoreader, NetNewsWire or Thunderbird, add
`https://sannerlab.github.io/news/` to the reader; it finds the RSS feed on its own. If the reader
asks for the feed itself, use `https://sannerlab.github.io/news/index.xml`. Browsers show the feed
as raw XML: it is meant for feed readers.
